detail_text: PLEASE THOUROHLY READ THE FOLLOWING Please note that this sources sought notice may go inactive before the March 2, 2026 deadline. THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE ONLY. For the purpose of this posting,please disregard the pre-employement screening and Section A and B of the personal qualifications and compliance section under the specification document. We are SOLELY looking to see if there is a market that is capable of completing this action. For the purpose of this posting, you need to enusre that you are capable of doing/obtaining everything listed under Section 2 and Section 4 part 3 found in the specification document. Place of Performance: Fort Hood, Texas 76544 Period of Performance: Subject to Change Base Year: 01 APR 2026 – 31 MAR 2027 Option Year I: 01 APR 2027 – 31 MAR 2028 Option Year II: 01 APR 2028 – 31 MAR 2029 Option Year III: 01 APR 2029 – 31 MAR 2030 Option Year IV: 01 APR 2030 – 31 MAR 2031 Description of service (also found in draft PWS attachment): Is to provide dedicated facility monitoring, user support, administrative services, and operational coordination for all designated religious facilities at Fort Hood in support of the RSO mission. This includes, but is not limited to, securing and preparing facilities for all scheduled events, providing program and childcare oversight in accordance with established Army standards, performing a range of administrative tasks, and serving as the primary liaison between the RSO and facility maintenance personnel. The overall objective is to ensure a safe, secure, and supportive environment that enables the successful execution of all religious services and programs on the installation All questions must be submitted no later than 2:00 PM Central Time (UTC-5) on February 25, 2026 , to both the Contract Specialist and the Contract Officer at the above email addresses. Answer to questions will be provided NLT 2:00 PM Central Time (UTC-5) on February 27, 2026. E-mail is the preferred method for questions. Questions will only be answered via email. Your points of contact regarding this requirement are as follows: Contract Specialist: Chasity.n.griffin.civ@army.mil Contracting Officer: Marcellus.j.newson.civ@army.mil Please begin subject line on email with 26P4020.
